text:
Tessa: hey team — just hit first-day setup snags. 1Password invite never showed up, and Okta is refusing my passkey enrollment on my Linux laptop (Pop!_OS). Yubikey LED blinks when i touch it, but "enroll" hangs. Anyone seen this?
Jamal (IT): hi! welcome :) i can resend the 1P invite and check Okta. quick q: did you use your work email or personal when you signed up?
Tessa: work email (tessa@redwood.ai). checked spam. nothing from 1password. okta flow starts, asks to set up MFA, then shows "unsupported device" when I pick passkey.
Lisa (onboarding): iirc we send 1Password invites from the team console. @Jamal can you resend? also @tessa do you have Okta Verify or Google Authenticator set up as a fallback?
Jamal (IT): resending 1Password invite now. give it a minute. for Okta: two things to try — ensure WebAuthn is allowed for your org and try enrolling via Chrome (not firefox) on linux. also check `lsusb` to confirm device recognized.
Tessa: resend received, thanks! trying lsusb:
Tessa: ```
$ lsusb
Bus 001 Device 005: ID 1050:0407 Yubico.com Yubikey 5/5 NFC OTP+U2F+CCID
```
Tessa: so system sees it. enrollment still fails with "Client error: NotAllowedError" in browser devtools.
eng-infra: NotAllowedError usually means the origin isn't allowed or browser blocked credential. Make sure you're on https://okta.redwood.ai (not http). Chrome also needs to be started without --enable-webauthn-testing-api. Also check Settings > Privacy > Security > Use secure DNS sometimes interferes.
onboarding-bot: FYI — 1Password invite accepted by Tessa at 1860004365.
Tessa: ok switched to Chrome and used the org url, same error. DevTools shows: `DOMException: The operation was aborted. (NotAllowedError)`. Any Okta org-level toggles?
Jamal (IT): I checked org policy — WebAuthn enabled and passkeys allowed for "All users". I just toggled "Allow passkeys from new devices" off/on to nudge the config. Can you retry?
Tessa: retried after toggle, enrollment succeeded! yubikey registered as "tessa-key-1". 1Password invite accepted. thanks y'all.
Lisa (onboarding): woo! leaving a quick note: if anyone else on linux hits this, try Chrome + org url + have IT toggle WebAuthn if stuck. i'll add to onboarding checklist. :tada:
Jamal (IT): marking this one resolved. ping me if the yubikey doesn't unlock ssh — we can push an authorized_keys snippet or let dev infra register your pubkey.
Tessa: all good for now, ssh key imported to 1Password and works. thanks!
Jamal (IT): closing thread. :white_check_mark:
